segments.label: Cannon drawing — It changes the mind
Return to master — requirements and whisper

cues.subject: urban
cues.text: Urban stands upright and unrolls the cannon drawing across the table.

cues.speaker: urban
cues.text: A gun this size does not defend a wall. It changes the mind of the man approaching it.

cues.subject: urban
cues.text: Urban begins speaking, leans over the table and points at the cannon drawing.

cues.subject: urban
cues.text: Urban settles with his left hand braced on the table and right hand indicating the drawing.

cues.speaker: loukas
cues.text: It changes the mind of the treasurer first.

cues.subject: urban
cues.text: Urban tilts his head, puzzled by Loukas. The emperor asks his question off-screen.

cues.speaker: urban
cues.text: Bronze. Powder. Charcoal. Masons. Carpenters. Oxen. A foundry that can breathe without collapsing. And pay enough that my men do not sell the design before the mold dries.

cues.subject: loukas
cues.text: Loukas leans toward the emperor’s near ear to whisper inaudibly.

cues.subject: loukas
cues.text: Loukas reaches the emperor’s ear and holds the private whisper through the end.
